name: Guided Deep Sleep Meditation
equipment: A quiet space to lie down
instructions: Lie down in your sleep position rather than sitting up -- this session is meant to carry you straight into sleep.
Let your body get heavy with each exhale; there is no goal here except releasing tension.
If your mind wanders to tomorrow's tasks, gently return attention to the guide's voice without frustration.
Follow tonight's full guided deep sleep meditation through to the end.
